title: Chief of Staff
leads: The Recruiters, and at scale the Trainers and the Compliance and Safety Manager.
where: The Cairo office. Some work is remote
hours: Office days. Reachable the same day for a lawyer or a missing paper
summary: You own the people, the papers, and this map. Everyone joins the company through you.

posting.headline: Chief of Staff (people, papers, and the map), Cairo
posting.about: We run video recording teams at factories, warehouses, farms, and construction sites across Cairo. Workers wear a small camera on a cap while they do their normal job. The Chief of Staff runs the office side: recruiting, onboarding paperwork, wearer files, the handbook, legal filings, site paperwork, and the company map. Everyone joins the company through you.
do: Recruit for every seat. Screen each name in the same week.
Write offer letters, collect onboarding papers, and run onboarding screening.
Keep every wearer's file complete before a phone goes on them.
Keep the employee handbook and this company map current.
Handle filings with the company lawyer: tax card, ITIDA, data protection, social insurance.
Paper every new site after Adham closes it: the site contract and the papers the site needs.
At 6:15 PM, take the chase list of sites with no daily report. Chase every one before 8:00 PM.
Hire two Recruiters in October, then hand them every open seat.
need: You have run hiring, contracts, or an office in Egypt before.
Careful with paper. A missing form or a missed date is yours to catch.
Clear and short in writing, in Arabic and English.
Calm on the phone with a lawyer, a site owner, or a nervous applicant.
plus: You have worked with a company lawyer on filings.
You have recruited for a field team before.
offer: A steady monthly wage, paid on time.
A seat at the daily meeting with the CEO and the Director of Operations.
Every rule and route already written down. You keep the map.
Two Recruiters under you from October, so the open seats do not all land on you.
posting.apply: Send your name, where you live, a phone number, and the offices or teams you have run. We call back within two working days.

offer.heading: Offer of employment
paragraphs: We are pleased to offer you the position of Chief of Staff at KMSC. You will report to {manager}, the CEO.
Your start date is {start}. In your first weeks you take over the onboarding files, the wearer files, and the handbook, and join the daily meeting with {manager} and the Director of Operations.

terms.label: Place of work
terms.v: The Cairo office. Some work is remote

terms.label: Hours
terms.v: Office days. Reachable the same day for a lawyer or a missing paper. At 6:15 PM the chase list of missing daily reports comes to you

terms.label: Pay
terms.v: {pay} per month, paid at the end of the month

conditions: A copy of your national ID.
Your signature on the rules, the consent form, and the fraud briefing.
One account in your own name. Accounts are never shared.
expect: Nobody starts without complete papers, whoever recommended them.
Every site with no daily report is chased at 6:15 PM, and the reason is known before 8:00 PM.
No filing misses its date in silence. {manager} hears the same day.
offer.closing: Please sign below to accept this offer. We look forward to working with you.

handbook.purpose: The client pays for accepted hours: filmed by people with papers, at sites with papers, on a map everyone can read. You own the people who join, their papers, the site papers, and this map. A floor short of a person or a form is yours to fix the same day.
outcomes: Everyone joins through you: screened, papers complete, day one signed.
Every wearer has a full file before a phone goes on their head.
No filing is late. Every site has its papers before launch day.
The 6:15 PM chase list is worked before 8:00 PM, and Moharam knows which site is still missing.
daily: Morning. Open seats and referrals. Screen every new name this week.
Same day. Confirm every ID photo and signed form a Portfolio Manager sends you.
Meet Adham and Moharam with hiring, papers, and the open seats.
6:15 PM. The chase list of sites with no daily report reaches you. Call each site lead. A site still missing at 8:00 PM counts as zero.
weekly: Once a week. Every open seat: who is in the pipeline and when they start.
Once a week. Check the map against what changed: a name, a rule, a route.
monthly: Month end. Count the open seats and the days each one took to fill, with the Recruiters.
Month end. Check next month's filing dates with the lawyer.
standards: Nobody starts without papers, whoever recommended them. No ID, no phone.
A launch gets Moharam's yes only after you confirm every wearer's file is complete.
A Portfolio Manager finds a site. Adham closes it. You paper it.
A missed filing date reaches Adham the same day, never a week later.
A breach: you and the lawyer tell the regulator within 72 hours. Adham tells the client.
never: Nobody starts, and nobody films, before every line of onboarding screening is done.
A removed worker never comes back, and an old account is never used again.
Saying the client's name to anyone outside the company ends the job.

firstMonth.what: Take over the onboarding files, the wearer files, and the handbook. Join the daily meeting.
Work the 6:15 PM chase list yourself. Meet the lawyer and list every filing date.
Take one new hire from referral to day one. Paper one new site.
Every open seat has a pipeline in writing. Adham signs you off.

measures: Days from referral to day one, for every hire.
Wearer files complete before launch day, every launch.
Filings on their date. Zero missed.
Sites still missing a daily report at 8:00 PM, per week.
handbook.call: Adham for anything you cannot settle, and for anything about the client. Moharam for the field and any incident. Ahmed Alaa for money. Youssef Medhat for quality. The Planning and Logistics Lead for gear, the store, and the hub. Moharam covers people and screening when you are away.
